issue_request: FHIR-16449 was a Published Vocab change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to remove the ValueSet $expand limitedExpansion input parameter and update count documentation because servers decide when expansions are too expensive while clients can use count for partial results.
initial_application: Jira comments cite svn revision 14008. The corresponding git-svn commit af02669d4245739a4c4ea146117faca6ad0fb4c9 removed the expand.limitedExpansion row from the then-authoritative ValueSet spreadsheet, added operation prose about using count to request a subset for limited purposes, and recorded the breaking change in history/ballot text.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/valueset/list-ValueSet-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/ValueSet-expand. The current OperationDefinition XML preserves the removal and count guidance after source refactoring. Later FHIR-55914 confirms non-core CRMI references to limitedExpansion were stale; FHIR-40717 separately addressed valueset-toocostly clarification and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active core source already implements the published FHIR-16449 decision, and adding duplicate wording to the count parameter would not materially change implementer understanding.
